name: Children And Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that from their earliest moments, children are affected by sin, as the imagination of the heart is evil from youth (Genesis 8:21) and the wicked go astray from the womb (Psalms 58:3). Yet, God knows and sanctifies individuals even before birth (Jeremiah 1:5), demonstrating His sovereign grace. While many, including those unable to discern right from left, are under sin's dominion (Jonah 4:11), salvation and eternal life are offered freely through Jesus Christ to all who call upon the Lord (Romans 6:23; 10:13).
